programme.title: Love at First Lie
programme.desc: When Sarah Goldman, a lovely young school teacher in Chicago, wants to please her parents, she invents a boyfriend whom she believes will be the man of her mother's dreams. The masquerade works flawlessly for a time and brings comic situations, but in the end, their lives are irrevocably changed.
